serviceAccount.name: devtrack-sa
serviceAccount.description: Least-privilege service account used by DevTrack container on Cloud Run

requiredRoles.description: Provides read and write access to Cloud Firestore documents and collections
Enables writing application structured logs to Cloud Logging
Enables emitting runtime latency and container metrics to Cloud Monitoring

cloudBuildRoles.description: Allows Cloud Build service account to deploy new revisions to Cloud Run
Allows Cloud Build to act as the Cloud Run service identity
Allows pushing container images to Google Artifact Registry
